sentences.11.2 Det er typisk norsk å dra på hytta: 11.2 It is typically Norwegian to go to the cabin
sentences.Synne studerer i Trondheim, men i helga: Synne studies in Trondheim, but at the weekend she is visiting her parents.
She meets Viola, and they talk.
sentences.Hva skal du gjøre i ferien, Viola?: What are you going to do in the holidays, Viola?
sentences.Jeg skal være sammen med familien på hyt: I'm going to be with the family at the cabin in the mountains. I really like being at the cabin. It's so cosy there. What about you?
sentences.Jeg liker bedre å reise til utlandet i f: I prefer travelling abroad in the holidays. I'm going to the sunny south.
sentences.Jeg gleder meg til litt varmere vær, men: I'm looking forward to some warmer weather, but a cabin trip is nice too.
sentences.Ja, men hytta er enkel, uten strøm og va: Yes, but the cabin is basic, without electricity or water, and we have to use an outdoor toilet.
sentences.Det er ganske vanlig med gammeldagse hyt: Old-fashioned cabins are quite common in Norway.
sentences.De kan være koseligere enn moderne hytte: They can be cosier than modern cabins.
sentences.Er det fint å gå på tur der?: Is it nice to go hiking there?
sentences.Ja, veldig. I ferien skal vi gå opp på G: Yes, very. In the holidays we're going to climb Galdhøpiggen.
That will surely be a great trip.
sentences.Ja, jeg gleder meg. Vi skal gå lange tur: Yes, I'm looking forward to it. We're going to go on long walks and take packed lunches and hot chocolate. In Italy we have lots of mountain peaks that are much higher than Galdhøpiggen, but I don't usually go hiking in the mountains in Italy.
sentences.Husk at det er kaldt på fjellet, da!: Remember that it's cold in the mountains, though!
Yes, it's much warmer in the south.
sentences.Jeg skal ligge på stranda og slappe av e: As for me, I'm going to lie on the beach and relax for a week.
sentences.Vi skal også slappe av. Vi skal lese bøk: We're going to relax too. We're going to read books and play games.
sentences.Det høres fint ut. Etter sydenturen skal: That sounds nice. After the trip south I'm just going to stay at home.
sentences.Pleier nordmenn å være hjemme i ferien?: Do Norwegians usually stay at home in the holidays?
sentences.Ja, mange nordmenn liker best å kose seg: Yes, many Norwegians like best to take it easy at home. I have to go now. I'm going home to have dinner.
sentences.Men klokka er jo bare fire. Å, ja! Nordm: But it's only four o'clock. Oh, yes! Norwegians eat dinner much earlier than Italians.
sentences.Sammendrag Viola og Synne snakker om fer: Summary Viola and Synne talk about the holidays.
Viola is going on a trip to the cabin.
sentences.Familien som hun bor hos, har ei enkel h: The family she lives with has a basic cabin with an outdoor toilet.
Synne is going to the sunny south.
It is warmer there than in Norway.
sentences.Både Synne og Viola skal slappe av i fer: Both Synne and Viola are going to relax in the holidays.
